nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_12
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Check if there\'s a valid wall near the character\'s feet. The trace begins near the bottom of the capsule, then moves a short distance towards the desired side of the character. The trace lengths and radius are based on the character\'s capsule size to support characters of different sizes.\r
\r
This is done to prevent the character from continuing to wall run if the bottom half of their body is hanging off the bottom of a wall.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_13
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If a valid wall is detected, return True and take no further action.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_14
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If a valid wall is not detected, return false and stop the wall run if one is active.
